newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi's beer shipments rise 10 pct yr/yr in May.
newsitem.headline: Asahi's beer shipments rise 10 pct yr/yr in May.

text.p: Asahi Breweries Ltd's beer sales were robust in May despite unseasonally cold weather which dampened sales of other Japanese breweries.
Asahi, Japan's second-biggest beer maker, said on Thursday its beer shipments totalled 195,221 kilolitres (kl) in May, up 10.0 percent from the same month a year earlier.
"Sales rose in May mainly because of very strong demand for our mainstay 'Super Dry'," said an Asahi spokesman.
Japan's largest beer maker Kirin Brewery Co Ltd said its beer shipments fell by 10.2 percent in May from the previous year to 249,120 kl.
Third-largest Sapporo Breweries Ltd's beer shipments fell 13.9 percent year-on-year to 92,726 kl.
In domestic market share, Asahi is steadily catching up with industry leader Kirin.
Asahi said its share in total shipments among Japan's top five beer makers in May rose to 34.2 percent from 29.7 percent a year ago, while that of Kirin fell to 43.7 percent from 45.4 percent.
Japan's top five beer makers are Kirin, Asahi, Sapporo, Suntory Ltd and the Okinawa-based Orion Breweries Ltd.
